item.title: Card Prompts Adapted from Li Jigang’s “Seven Weapons”
item.description:
What are Li Jigang’s “Seven Weapons” prompts?

The “Seven Weapons” are seven thinking-tool prompts written by the prompt engineer Li Jigang between October and November 2024. They are effective at improving the quality of a large language model’s output. One of their most distinctive features is that they have the model output an SVG card directly, according to preset rules.
